fact: Hespress, citing unnamed sources, reports an Interior Ministry circular giving ten regional walis three weeks to digitise paper civil-status registers into the national civil register under Law 36-21, with Casablanca-Settat and Rabat-Salé-Kénitra already holding near 20 million electronic records.

Atalayar reports the DGCT international tender, 194 million dirhams in five regional lots, to digitise over 38 million civil-status acts in 1,821 offices into a centralised database, with births after 1950 and deaths after 2003 prioritised.

The Interior Ministry says its civil-status management system (SGEC) is generalised across all civil-status offices in the Kingdom and handles birth declarations, with over 1,300,000 acts declared or issued.
